_evidence_notes.depends_on_honesty_caveat: The depends_on edges below are NOT a transcription of usb_top_env.sv's real build_phase creation order -- read directly this pass, that order is (1) sys_virt_seqr/ep_check/perf_mon/xfer_sb/frame_util per-port loop, (2) dma_env (ifdef block, lines 356-367), (3) usb_host_agent/usb_mon_agent per-port loop (lines 386-428), (4) apb_env (436), (5) axi_env (443), (6) clk_rst_agent/sideband_agent (447-448), (7) reg_seqr/virt_seqr (450-451) -- i.e. clk_rst_agent is created NEAR THE END in the real file, not first, and the real file asserts no explicit inter-component ordering dependency via comments the way vip_components' depends_on models it (its ordering comments are about *file include* order for type visibility, e.g. lines 20-66, not about build_phase creation order). The one real, evidenced connect-time dependency is reg_seqr/virt_seqr wiring to apb_env.master.sequencer and axi_env.master[0].sequencer at lines 472-475, which DOES require apb_env/axi_env to already exist -- that edge below is real evidence. All other depends_on edges below (clk_rst_agent as a prerequisite for the agents/apb_env/axi_env, mon_agent depending on its paired host_agent) are ASSERTED BY THIS EXPERIMENT ONLY, as a plausible/conventional structural ordering (reset/clock-domain component before protocol agents; monitor sharing its active agent's config), to exercise topological_build_order() with a non-trivial dependency graph -- they are not claims about what usb_top_env.sv's real code requires.
_evidence_notes.v3_port_indexed_rewrite: v2 (examples/generated_usb_real_evidence_v2/manifest_inputs/usb_env_manifest_v2.json, left UNCHANGED as a historical artifact) modeled the real dual-port usb_host_agent[NUM_USB_PORTS]/usb_mon_agent[NUM_USB_PORTS] arrays (usb_top_env.sv lines 77-78) as 4 SEPARATELY-NAMED FLAT SCALAR vip_components entries (host_agent0/host_agent1/mon_agent0/mon_agent1) -- an approximation that does NOT emit a real SV array or for-loop, unlike the real file. All other vip_components entries (clk_rst_agent, sideband_agent, apb_env, axi_env, dma_env, reg_seqr) and every other real-evidence-cited field are UNCHANGED from v2 verbatim -- only the host_agent0/host_agent1/mon_agent0/mon_agent1 portion and the depends_on edge that referenced them (mon_agent -> host_agent, collapsed from mon_agent0->host_agent0 / mon_agent1->host_agent1 since both are now single graph nodes) were rewritten, plus the addition of top-level port_count. CORRECTION vs a prior pass's guess: sys_virt_seqr's real class_type is svt_usb_system_virtual_sequencer, a VIP type -- NOT a project usb_-prefixed custom type as the naming pattern of ep_check/perf_mon/xfer_sb might suggest; confirmed directly at declaration line 146 and create() call line 330. OBSERVED BUT NOT MODELED: ep_check[p]'s real create() call at line 332 (usb_ep_check::type_id::create($sformatf("ep_check_%0d", p))) passes ONLY a name string, no parent-component argument -- unlike every other create() call in this file, which all pass `this` (or, for dma_cfg/cfg, are also called with only a name). The vip_components schema has no field for this nuance, so it is recorded here as a citation only. depends_on for the new per-port entries (sys_virt_seqr/ep_check/perf_mon/xfer_sb/frame_util/dma_sb) is usb_top_cfg only: real evidence is that all six are created inside the SAME per-port loop (lines 328-354) gated by `if (!cfg.enable_port[p]) continue;` at line 329, and cfg itself is built earlier at lines 309-313 -- both the real creation order AND the functional reference to cfg.enable_port[p] support this edge. TWO CANDIDATE EDGES WERE DELIBERATELY LEFT OUT despite a real connect_phase wire existing, because the real BUILD-PHASE creation order contradicts them: (1) sys_virt_seqr[p].host_virt_sequencer = usb_host_agent[p].virt_sequencer at connect_phase lines 485-488 might suggest sys_virt_seqr depends_on host_agent, but sys_virt_seqr is actually built at line 330, inside the FIRST per-port loop, strictly BEFORE usb_host_agent is built at line 414, inside a LATER per-port loop -- asserting that edge would misrepresent the real file; (2) dma_env.master[p].monitor.item_observed_port.connect(dma_sb[p].dma_export) at connect_phase lines 522-536 might suggest dma_sb depends_on dma_env, but dma_sb is built at line 350 (inside the first per-port loop, lines 328-354) strictly BEFORE dma_env is built at line 361 (a separate ifdef block, lines 356-367) -- same reasoning, edge omitted. virt_seqr's depends_on (host_agent, apb_env, axi_env, reg_seqr) is by contrast the STRONGEST-evidenced edge added this pass: it is corroborated by BOTH the real build_phase creation order (virt_seqr is created last, at line 451, strictly after usb_host_agent/apb_env/axi_env/reg_seqr at lines 414/436/443/450) AND real connect_phase references (lines 461-465, 472, 473, 475) that require all four to already exist. dma_cfg and usb_top_cfg both have empty depends_on: their own creation code (lines 359 and 309-313 respectively) makes no reference to any other component in this manifest, so no real edge was found for either, and none was invented.
